instructions:
Rigby's Cloud Grants Feed #1: public US-federal opportunities from Grants.gov,
NIH RePORTER awards and OpenAlex papers only. Read-only, four tools. Always show
Grants.gov source URL and deadline; dates may be date-only or rolling, so check
source requirements. Show feed_generated_at and source timestamps; never present
stale data as fresh. Preserve score_evidence and coverage: neutral insufficient-data
scores are placeholders, not funding-gap findings. Scores are versioned descriptive
proxies, never predictions of success or proof of neglect. Missing research links
mean missing coverage, not no funding. Broad FOA/award-core paper associations do
not establish current-opportunity funding or topic relevance. Free search uses a
real snapshot at least seven days old with no scores or summaries; other tools
require a paid pass. No trials, patents, global coverage, subscriptions, write
actions or bulk-dump tools. Never invent opportunities, deadlines, amounts or links.

tools.name: opportunity_search
tools.description: Search public US-federal opportunities; preserve evidence flags and cite source URLs and dates.

tools.name: opportunity_get
tools.description: Get a full source-backed opportunity, preserving all layers, coverage and score evidence.

tools.name: opportunity_links
tools.description: Read confirmed award and paper edges with confidence and source URLs; no scores or summaries.

tools.name: gap_for_topic
tools.description: Describe topic portfolios with source counts and explicit thin-evidence limitations.

scope_note: Scaffold task check before tool implementations and T2.6 auth. Tools are registered stubs at this checkpoint; no later-phase implementation is claimed.
secret_handling: No key required before T2.6. Inspector secret store set to memory; acquired-token persistence disabled; local storage/cache paths ignored by Git.
